HttpClient.cls is not shipped by this step and was never shipped by run 2 or run 3 -- remedy B dropped it before either run, and Tier2WebhookQueueable.cls:25 comments 'No HttpClient wrapper ... in this build (remedy B ...)'. The underlying security property clause (b) actually asks for -- no literal hostname, no Apex-set X-API-Key/Authorization header, endpoint composed as callout:OnCall_Tool -- is satisfied and verified by direct inspection (Tier2WebhookQueueable.cls:235 req.setEndpoint('callout:' + NAMED_CREDENTIAL); no setHeader call for Authorization or X-API-Key anywhere in the class). A reviewer ticking clause (b) literally against the named HttpClient.cls mechanism would find that file absent from the artefacts.
